title: oplismenus crus-galli var. colonum
intro: Oplismenus crus-galli var. colonum, commonly known as Barnyard grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Oplismenus crus-galli var. colonum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. However, further research is necessary to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
